DiaryEntry.title: DiaryEntry
DiaryEntry.description: A personal psychological diary entry associated with a specific calendar date, botanical mood state, reflection prompt, tags, and compressed photo memories.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID who owns this diary entry.

dateIso.description: Calendar date of the entry in YYYY-MM-DD format.

monthDay.description: Month and day in MM-DD format for On This Day past-year lookups.

title.description: Headline or key moment of the day.

content.description: Main psychological journal text for the day.

reflectionAnswer.description: User's personal reflection response to the prompt.

tags.description: List of keyword tags attached to the entry (max 15).

photosBase64.description: List of compressed Base64 photo thumbnails attached to the entry (max 4).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Per-user subcollection of personal psychological diary entries isolated by userId.
